name: Phone notifications per app
author: wizard
description: WizardOS Android app: what any app sends to Notifications (Messenger, Mail, your agent…) shows on your phone as its own notification under that app's name, also with Wizard closed. Each app gets its own Android notification channel, so you can mute one app in Android settings and keep the rest. A tap opens that app or the exact item. Quiet items and apps you set to Off in Notifications stay off the phone.
